title: an empty tail does not choose between variadic overloads
purpose: A call with no tail values fits every variadic overload with an empty fixed prefix equally and is ambiguous.

failure.justification: The call has no single most specific candidate; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. Either way the program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for typed and variadic overloads
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.8: equally specific candidates are ambiguous; declaration order is never a tie-breaker.
